message.workbay.break_warning: Breaking this Workbay leaves its bays behind. The machines keep running; you'll need code %s to get back in.
message.workbay.reject.assay_needs_bay: The Assay only works racked in a bay. It has no faces to connect to out here.
message.workbay.reject.kinetic: %s runs on rotational force. A bay can't turn a shaft.
message.workbay.reject.multiblock: %s is part of a multiblock. A bay holds one block; build it in a room instead.
message.workbay.reject.needs_neighbours: %s works by connecting to the blocks around it. A bay has no neighbours to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.no_bay: Every bay is full. Install an Expansion Plate for another.
message.workbay.reject.no_machine: %s has nothing running inside it. A bay can only hold a block with a block entity.
message.workbay.reject.no_ports: %s has no item, fluid or energy ports. A bus would have nothing to connect to.
message.workbay.reject.not_a_block: %s isn't a block. A bay holds machines.
message.workbay.reject.pack_denied: This pack doesn't allow %s to be hosted.
message.workbay.reject.recursion: A Workbay can't go inside a Workbay.
message.workbay.reject.world_interacting: %s works on the world around it. A bay is empty, so it would have nothing to do.
message.workbay.room_created: Workbay %s created. Write this code down — if you lose the block, an operator can get you back in with it.
